newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Duke Power lowered.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Duke Power lowered.

text.p: -- J.P. Morgan said in a research note that it lowered its recommendation on Duke Power to long-term buy from buy because the merger with PanEnergy Corp "changes the near-term earnings picture."

-- "The merger is premised on long-term strategic benefits and revenue/margin gains and provides very little in the way of near-term costs savings. Duke expects the transaction to be about four percent dilutive in the first full year (probably 1998) a little less so but still dilutive in 1999, and accretive in 2000 (though they won't say by how much)," the report states.
-- "This would mean our $3.70 1998 EPS estimate would come down to about $3.55, the same as 1997," the report said.
